text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a regional blue/green for router v2 across eu-west + us-east tonight. Need coordination on weight ramp and session affinity. Change window 00:30-01:30 UTC. Will follow staged cohorts.
liam: +1. what's the canary group and ramp steps?
maya: Canary is 1% traffic to green in eu-west for 5m, then 5% for 10m, 25% for 15m, then 100% if metrics OK. us-east will start 15m after eu-west hits 25%.
arthur: Checkpoint: confirm warm pool size and connection drain. we should pre-warm 2x expected QPS for green nodes.
ops-anna: pre-warm config: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/router-green -n infra` and put warm-up traffic via `wrk -t4 -c50 -d60s http://router-green.eu-west.internal/health`
maya: adding checklist: 1) version pin in routing config 2) LD canary toggles 3) health probes 4) fallback policy set to router-v1 5) runbook link posted
liam: how are we handling sticky sessions? cookie or header?
arthur: use header-based affinity `x-session-route`. router supports both, header preferred for websockets. set TTL to 300s.
maya: @deploy-bot please schedule and run preflight now
deploy-bot: scheduled preflight for 2148765432: running smoke tests, cert checks, config diff, verifying kv cache warmup. details: https://deploys.redwood/in/2148765432
sre-bot: baseline latency (p50/p95) — eu-west: 45ms/120ms, us-east: 40ms/110ms. canary SLAs: p95 < 180ms, error rate <0.5%
deploy-bot: preflight OK. diff:
```
- router config: route->variant=v1
+ router config: route->variant=v2
```
maya: We'll start 1% now. liam, monitor traces and logs. watch for surge on warm pools.
liam: watching. will post rolling metrics every 5m. if errors > 0.5% or p95 > 180ms we rollback.
arthur: if we need rollback, plan A: shift weights back to v1 immediately, plan B: scale down green and scale v1 up. keep session stickiness TTL 5m to reduce mismatches.
ops-anna: running canary curl check: `curl -I https://api.eu-west.redwood/health -H 'x-session-route: green'`
maya: canary at 1% -> green nodes showing healthy. p95 = 60ms, errors 0.02% :thumbsup:
liam: entering 5% stage in 5m. posting metrics: p50 48ms, p95 75ms, err 0.03%
arthur: confirm LB idle timeouts and drain window set to 90s on green. also set router fallback policy to immediate on 5xx spike.
maya: moving to 25% in 15m if stable. us-east will hold until eu-west 25% complete.
liam: at 25% now — p95 82ms, err 0.04%, 5xx spike history: none. ramping to 100% in 20m unless regressions.
ops-anna: note: session migration note — old sessions still bound to v1 cookies for TTL, expect tailing traffic for ~5m after full cutover.
sre-bot: guardrails check: error rate <0.5% (OK), p95 <180ms (OK), CPU/GPUs within expected (OK).
maya: green at 100% in eu-west. starting us-east canary at 1% now.
liam: us-east canary healthy. p95 70ms, err 0.01%. starting 5% ramp.
arthur: leaving circuit-breakers in place for first 60m after full shift. manual rollback trigger: `errors > 0.5% for 5m` or `p95 > 200ms for 5m`.
maya: if rollback needed, I'll run `deploy-bot rollback 2148765432 --immediate` and notify #incidents. keep all notes in the runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/bluegreen-router-v2
liam: agreed. metrics dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/routers/router-v2-canary-panel
ops-anna: after final hold, I'll prune green warm pool to nominal size and update autoscaler policies.
maya: final: holding at 100% for 20m, no anomalies. closing change window at 01:10 UTC. thanks team :tada:
liam: nice work. leaving postmortem checklist item to capture any small latency deltas.
arthur: thumbs up. will add notes about affinity header and drain times to the ops playbook.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: 2148765432 -> v2 live in eu-west and us-east. artifacts: s3://deploys/2148765432/logs
